title: Incheon Airport to Seoul Late at Night: Train, Bus or Taxi
description: Landed at Incheon Airport after the last train? Compare official late-night buses, taxi stands and wait-until-morning options for Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
html:
If you reach the public arrivals hall at Incheon Airport after the last train, use this terminal-by-terminal plan to choose a verified late-night bus, an official taxi or a wait for morning rail service.

Routes and official transport pages were checked on 29 August 2026. Departure times, fares, stops and payment methods can change; use the linked airport pages again on your travel date.

The key time is when you clear arrivals

Do not plan from the aircraft's scheduled landing time. Immigration, baggage claim, customs and the walk to the transportation center can move your usable departure time much later. Save your terminal number, hotel name, Korean address and nearest landmark before the flight. Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 have different boarding locations and different departure times.

Once you enter the public arrivals hall, follow this order:

  1. Check the live Airport Railroad departure for your terminal.
  2. If rail has finished, match an official late-night bus stop to your hotel area.
  3. If no bus gets you close enough, use the designated taxi stand or wait for morning service.

AREX is not an overnight train

AREX has an Express Train to Seoul Station and an All-Stop Train serving places such as Gimpo Airport and Hongik University. Regular rail service does not run continuously through the small hours. There is no standard 1 a.m. to 4 a.m. “AREX Night Service” to depend on. The official Seoul transport page currently describes the All-Stop operating window as ending around midnight, with exact service varying by station.

Before committing to rail, check the Incheon Airport Railroad guide and follow its link to the official AREX timetable. Search from “Incheon Int'l Airport Terminal 1” or “Terminal 2” for your date. If the last useful train leaves before you can reach the platform, move to the bus or taxi plan immediately rather than buying a ticket for an impossible connection.

Express or All-Stop when trains are still running

Use the Express Train when Seoul Station is the useful endpoint and its reserved departure fits your arrival. Use the All-Stop Train when Hongik University, Gimpo Airport or another intermediate station reduces your transfer. A train reaching Seoul Station is not the end of the trip: confirm that your onward subway still runs, or budget for a taxi from the station.

Official late-night buses to Seoul

Incheon Airport's current late-night network lists four Seoul routes. The best route is the one whose stop is closest to your accommodation, not simply the next bus shown on a board.

  • N6000: heads toward Gangnam Express Bus Terminal, with intermediate western Seoul stops.
  • N6002: heads toward Cheongnyangni and currently serves Hongdae and central Seoul stops.
  • N6701: heads toward Dongdaemun Design Plaza and currently serves Mapo, Seoul Station and Euljiro.
  • N6703: heads toward Gwangnaru and currently serves the COEX and Jamsil corridor.

Use the airport's separate official tables for Terminal 1 Seoul late-night buses and Terminal 2 Seoul late-night buses. Those pages show current departure times, boarding areas, stops, estimated travel times, fares and accepted purchase methods. Screenshot the correct terminal table after checking it on your arrival day.

Do not assume every bus accepts the same payment

The official tables distinguish ticket booths, automated machines and the Tmoney GO app by operator. A physical Tmoney transit card is useful for normal buses and subways, but it is not a reason to skip the specific boarding instructions for a late-night airport route. Follow the payment method shown for your bus and keep a card or cash alternative where the operator permits it.

Taxi: use only the designated stand

A taxi is the direct option when your group has heavy luggage, your hotel is far from a night-bus stop or you do not want another transfer after a long flight. Follow airport signs to the official taxi queue. The Incheon Airport taxi guide lists the stand locations, taxi categories, official international-taxi contact and current surcharge rules. The airport specifically warns passengers about illegal solicitation and overcharging by vehicles posing as taxis.

Before entering, show the driver the hotel's Korean address and phone number. Confirm the taxi type, ask whether the trip uses the meter or an official flat fare, and request a receipt. Tolls and night surcharges can affect the final amount, so this guide does not publish a guessed citywide fare.

When waiting for morning is the better choice

Waiting can make sense if you are traveling alone on a flexible schedule, your accommodation cannot accept a very early arrival, or the remaining night-bus stop would still require a long taxi ride. Stay in the public landside area, check the airport facility directory for your terminal, keep your luggage with you and recheck the first useful train rather than assuming the first departure goes to your final stop.

Do not enter a transit-only or restricted area to wait, and do not plan around a shop being open all night without checking that exact location. Tell your accommodation that you will arrive in the morning.

A five-minute arrival checklist

  • Confirm T1 or T2 before opening any timetable.
  • Turn on airport Wi-Fi and take a screenshot of the hotel address in Korean.
  • Check rail based on your current time at arrivals, not the landing time.
  • For a night bus, verify route, direction, stop number and payment method on the airport page.
  • For a taxi, ignore unsolicited rides and use the signed official stand.
  • Share the route or taxi details with a travel companion when practical.

Set up mobile data before leaving the terminal with the Korea SIM, eSIM and pocket WiFi guide. For the next day, review the CocoTrip Seoul area guide or place your confirmed airport transfer into CocoTrip's itinerary planner.

Frequently asked questions

Does AREX run after midnight?
Do not treat AREX as an overnight service. Exact final departures vary by train type, station and date; check the official timetable for your terminal.

Which night bus goes to Myeongdong?
Route stops and names can change. Compare your hotel's Korean address with the current N6002 and N6701 stop lists, then confirm the final walk or taxi connection.

Can I buy a transit card at the airport?
Transit cards are sold at airport locations, but opening hours and late-night bus payment rules vary. A card does not guarantee boarding on every airport bus.

What if my phone has no data?
Use airport Wi-Fi, the staffed information desk when open, ticket machines and posted official signs. Save the key pages and hotel address offline before departure.
